source.locator: Theorems 2.2, 2.3, and 3.1 (equations (7) and (9), and the Airy expansion), pp. 5--6 of arXiv v1

attestation.note: Checked directly against arXiv:2608.13822v1. Theorem 2.2 identifies the unrestricted binary procedure game, Theorem 2.3 gives exact bounded-endpoint scaling, and Theorem 3.1 gives the Airy expansion.

proposed_core_edits.name: L
proposed_core_edits.reason: Adds the lower endpoint needed by the exact bounded-outcome reduction.

proposed.name: L
proposed.def: The fixed lower endpoint of the bounded potential-outcome interval, with \(L<U\).

proposed_core_edits.name: U
proposed_core_edits.reason: Adds the upper endpoint needed by the exact bounded-outcome reduction.

proposed.name: U
proposed.def: The fixed upper endpoint of the bounded potential-outcome interval, with \(L<U\).

proposed_core_edits.name: \mathfrak D
proposed_core_edits.reason: Names the fixed assignment-law class whose preservation is part of the endpoint reduction.

proposed.name: \mathfrak D
proposed.def: A fixed nonempty class of assignment laws for a specified finite arm set, each selected independently of the potential-outcome schedule; its members may have arbitrary cross-unit dependence.

proposed_core_edits.name: R^{\mathfrak D}_{n,[L,U]}(c)
proposed_core_edits.reason: Names the fixed-class bounded-outcome minimax risk.

proposed.name: R^{\mathfrak D}_{n,[L,U]}(c)
proposed.def: The value defined in \(\mathrm{def:bounded\text{-}risk\text{-}game}\) when nature ranges over \([L,U]^{n\times K}\) and the design ranges over \(\mathfrak D\).

proposed_core_edits.name: R^{\mathfrak D}_{n,\{0,1\}}(c)
proposed_core_edits.reason: Names the fixed-class binary minimax risk paired with the bounded game.

proposed.name: R^{\mathfrak D}_{n,\{0,1\}}(c)
proposed.def: The value defined in \(\mathrm{def:bounded\text{-}risk\text{-}game}\) when nature ranges over \(\{0,1\}^{n\times K}\) and the design ranges over \(\mathfrak D\).

proposed_core_edits.name: R_{n,[L,U]}(c)
proposed_core_edits.reason: Names the unrestricted bounded-outcome minimax risk used by the bounded three-arm corollary.

proposed.name: R_{n,[L,U]}(c)
proposed.def: The value in \(\mathrm{def:bounded\text{-}risk\text{-}game}\) when nature ranges over \([L,U]^{n\times K}\) and the design ranges over all outcome-independent assignment laws.

proposed_core_edits.name: R_{n,\{0,1\}}(c)
proposed_core_edits.reason: Makes the binary specialization of the common bounded-risk notation explicit.

proposed.name: R_{n,\{0,1\}}(c)
proposed.def: The unrestricted binary specialization of \(\mathrm{def:bounded\text{-}risk\text{-}game}\), equal to \(R_n(c)\) from \(\mathrm{def:risk\text{-}game}\).

proposed_core_edits.name: \rho_n^\star
proposed_core_edits.reason: Names the published unrestricted two-treatment minimax benchmark used in the submodel comparison.

proposed.name: \rho_n^\star
proposed.def: The unrestricted binary two-treatment minimax risk, equivalently the reduced binomial-experiment value in Sudijono, Dobriban, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (2026).

proposed_core_edits.reason: Defines the fixed-class bounded and binary games needed for the exact endpoint reduction without changing the binary kernel.
